village-6516.text: This bur oak stands on the 400 block of N Kenilworth Ave in the Frank Lloyd Wright–Prairie School of Architecture Historic District. The 1830s federal land survey mapped this spot as timber, a small wooded patch in what was mostly prairie. When the house at 427 N Kenilworth Ave was built in 1870, this oak could have been anything from a sapling to about 169 years old. Local accounts describe a 'Kenilworth Witness Oak', a bur oak the Potawatomi are said to have used as a landmark on the route back to the Des Plaines River. Whether this is that tree is unconfirmed.
